c74object.name: lp.pfff64~
c74object.description: lp.pfff64~ generates Brownian (1/f^2) noise without overflow. Like lp.pfff~, but computed in 64-bit integers, with an optional look-ahead limiter (off by default).

method.name: int
method.description: In the left inlet: NN factor. In the 2nd inlet: Limiter on/off, default off.

method.name: limit
method.digest: Turn the look-ahead limiter on (1) or off (0)
method.description: Turn the look-ahead limiter on (1) or off (0).

method.name: mode
method.description: Set the overflow mode: 0 native, 1 PPC (clips), 2 Intel (jumps to the minimum), 3 PC415 (wraps).

method.name: tattle
method.digest: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same)
method.description: Print the state of the object to the Max Console (double-click does the same).
